description: Provides a base element class for Windows Runtime UI objects. FrameworkElement defines common API that support UI interaction and the automatic layout system. FrameworkElement also defines API related to data binding, defining and examining the object tree, and tracking object lifetime.

properties.name: IsLoaded
properties.description: Gets a value that indicates whether the element has been added to the element tree and is ready for interaction.

events.name: Loaded
events.description: Occurs when a FrameworkElement has been constructed and added to the object tree, and is ready for interaction.

events.name: Unloaded
events.description: Occurs when this object is no longer connected to the main object tree.
